name: @pipeworx/mcp-fr-decp

tools.name: fr_decp_search_contracts
tools.description: Search FRENCH PUBLIC-CONTRACT AWARDS (données essentielles de la commande publique / DECP) — the legally-required disclosure every French public buyer (ministries, local authorities, public hospitals, public bodies) files about a contract it has AWARDED: who bought, who won, how much, when, and under which CPV code. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "who did a French public body award a contract to", "French government contracts with company X", or "public spending on CPV code Y in France". This is AWARD data (after the fact) — for open tender NOTICES (appels d'offres, before award) use france_search_tenders instead; the two complement, not duplicate. Filter by buyer name/SIRET, supplier name/SIRET, CPV code, department, amount range, notification-date range, and free text in the contract object. Returns total_matches (the true count across the whole filtered set, not just this page) plus the matching contracts, newest notification first by default.

keyword.description: Free-text search within the contract object/description (objet), e.g. "informatique", "voirie", "nettoyage".

buyer_name.description: Substring match on the awarding public buyer's name (acheteur), e.g. "VILLE DE PARIS", "REGION GRAND EST".

buyer_siret.description: Exact 14-digit SIRET/SIREN of the awarding public buyer.

supplier_name.description: Substring match on the awarded supplier's name (titulaire), e.g. "VEOLIA", "VINCI".

supplier_siret.description: Exact 14-digit SIRET of the awarded supplier.

cpv_code.description: CPV (Common Procurement Vocabulary) code, exact 8-digit code or a leading-digits prefix, e.g. "45000000" for all construction works, "45233140" for road works.

department_code.description: French department code of the AWARDING BUYER, e.g. "75" (Paris), "13" (Bouches-du-Rhône), "2A"/"2B" (Corsica).

min_amount.description: Minimum contract amount in euros (montant, HT).

max_amount.description: Maximum contract amount in euros (montant, HT).

sort.description: Sort order. Default date_desc (most recently notified first).

limit.description: Number of contracts to return (1-100). Default 20.

offset.description: Result offset for pagination within the matched set. Default 0.

tools.name: fr_decp_get_contract
tools.description: Fetch a single French public-contract award (DECP) by its unique record id (uid), as returned by fr_decp_search_contracts. Returns the full award record: buyer, supplier SIRET, amount, dates, CPV, procedure, duration, and geography for both parties.

uid.description: The DECP record uid from a fr_decp_search_contracts result, e.g. "217500016000192026F10374_32300000".

tools.name: fr_decp_contract_stats
tools.description: Aggregate French public-contract AWARD counts (DECP), grouped by one dimension, over the same filters as fr_decp_search_contracts (buyer, supplier, CPV, department, amount range, date range, keyword). Answers "which departments/regions/CPV codes/buyer types won the most French public contracts matching X" without pulling every matching row. Returns one row per group value with its contract count, sorted by count descending.

group_by.description: Dimension to group by: acheteur_departement_nom (buyer department), acheteur_region_nom (buyer region), acheteur_categorie (buyer type, e.g. Commune/Région), titulaire_categorie (supplier size category, e.g. PME/ETI/GE), titulaire_departement_nom (supplier department), codeCPV (CPV code), procedure (award procedure), type (Travaux/Fournitures/Services).

keyword.description: Free-text filter within the contract object (objet).

buyer_name.description: Substring match on the awarding buyer's name.

buyer_siret.description: Exact SIRET/SIREN of the awarding buyer.

supplier_name.description: Substring match on the awarded supplier's name.

supplier_siret.description: Exact SIRET of the awarded supplier.

cpv_code.description: CPV code, exact or leading-digits prefix.

department_code.description: French department code of the awarding buyer.

limit.description: Number of group rows to return (1-100). Default 20.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fr-decp forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fr-decp pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
